notes.title: July 1st (Update) Game Version (1.3.3.10)
notes.content:
New features:

Added a settings interface to show/hide the "poop" function.
Added an option to set the viewing mode, including an option to turn on/off the music and set the number of fish displayed in the viewing mode.
Added support for screens with a 21:9 aspect ratio.
Bug fixes:

Fixed the issue where the sliding of the collection interface did not return to its original position.
Fixed the issue where images in the help interface were not displayed.

notes.title: June 23rd (Update)
notes.content:
Optimizing the Quantity of Fish Waste
Adding a One-click Cleanup Function for Waste
Updating the Settings Interface
Adding a Toggle for Waste Special Effects
Adding a Toggle for Waste Text Prompts
Adding a Debug Mode Switch

To ensure that you receive timely assistance whenever you encounter any issues during the game, we have provided a new way to provide feedback. If you encounter any problems during the game, please follow the steps below:

Press and hold the Ctrl and Alt keys simultaneously for about 1 second. This will trigger a debug pop-up window.
In the debug window that appears, you will see a button labeled 'Copy'. Please click on it, and the relevant information will be copied to your clipboard.
Use the Ctrl+V shortcut to paste the content from your clipboard into an editor or application.
Then, you can send this information to us via email, chat, or other methods.
Email address: 1076586010@qq.com

We highly value your feedback, which will help us locate and resolve issues more quickly. Thank you again for your cooperation and support. We look forward to providing you with an even better gaming experience!
